title: Wearable
subtitle: 「穿戴式／身上佩戴／可隨身佩戴」，究竟是哪一種 wearable？
description: 「穿戴式／身上佩戴／可隨身佩戴」，究竟是哪一種 wearable？

words.meaning: 佩戴在身上的；身體穿戴式的
words.note: 最直接、最常見的正式替換之一，表示裝置、感測器或設備直接佩戴在身體或衣物上；常見於科技、醫療和研究語境。
words.example: The study used body-worn sensors to track movement throughout the day.
words.exampleZh: 這項研究使用身體穿戴式感測器追蹤全日活動。

exercises.original: The researchers gave participants wearable sensors to record movement.
exercises.zh: 研究人員給參加者佩戴式感測器記錄活動。
exercises.upgrade: body-worn · 佩戴在身上的；身體穿戴式的

options.explanation: portable = 可攜帶但未必佩戴在身上。
handheld = 需要手持，與 sensors worn during movement 不符。
body-worn = sensors + 直接佩戴在身上，是 body-worn 的典型技術語境。
implantable = 植入體內，意思完全不同。
accessory = 未表達感測器佩戴方式。

exercises.original: The study compares data from wearable cameras and fixed cameras.
exercises.zh: 這項研究比較身體穿戴式相機和固定相機的數據。
exercises.upgrade: body-worn · 佩戴在身上的；身體穿戴式的

options.explanation: handheld = 和 fixed camera 對比時，原句強調佩戴。
body-worn = 與 fixed cameras 對比，body-worn cameras 很自然。

exercises.original: Police officers tested new wearable recording equipment.
exercises.zh: 警員測試新的身體穿戴式錄影設備。
exercises.upgrade: body-worn · 佩戴在身上的；身體穿戴式的

options.explanation: body-worn = 警員身上佩戴的錄影設備最自然描述為 body-worn。

words.note: 描述性說法，當 wearable 強調某物是作為裝置直接佩戴在身上時可用；較適合解釋性文字。
words.example: The monitor is worn as a device on the wrist during exercise.
words.exampleZh: 這個監測器在運動時作為裝置佩戴在手腕上。

exercises.original: The sensor is wearable on the upper arm during training.
exercises.zh: 感測器在訓練時作為裝置佩戴於上臂。
exercises.upgrade: worn as a device · 作為裝置佩戴的

options.explanation: handheld = 上臂佩戴不是手持。
portable only = 可攜帶但未指出佩戴。
worn as a device = 解釋某物作為裝置佩戴的位置時，這個描述性說法可用。

exercises.original: The monitor is wearable on the chest for several hours.
exercises.zh: 監測器可以作為裝置佩戴在胸前數小時。
exercises.upgrade: worn as a device · 作為裝置佩戴的

options.explanation: handheld = 需要手拿，和 chest 不符。
worn as a device = 胸前佩戴、持續使用的裝置可用這種解釋性改寫。

exercises.original: This tracker is wearable during sleep.
exercises.zh: 這個追蹤器睡眠時可作為裝置佩戴。
exercises.upgrade: worn as a device · 作為裝置佩戴的

options.explanation: worn as a device = 當重點只是說它能作為裝置佩戴使用時，這個表達可接受。

words.meaning: 可隨身佩戴的；可在身上攜帶的
words.note: 當 wearable 的核心是裝置可直接隨身攜帶、無需手持時可用；比 body-worn 更偏便攜性。
words.example: The recorder is portable on the body and can operate for several hours.
words.exampleZh: 這個錄音器可直接隨身佩戴，並可運作數小時。

exercises.original: The recorder is wearable and does not need to be carried by hand.
exercises.zh: 這個錄音器可直接隨身佩戴，不需要手持。
exercises.upgrade: portable on the body · 可隨身佩戴的；可在身上攜帶的

options.explanation: handheld = 與 does not need to be carried by hand 矛盾。
portable on the body = 原句特別突出不用手拿、可隨身攜帶，portable on the body 很合適。
mobile phone = 是另一種裝置類型。

exercises.original: The device is wearable during long field surveys.
exercises.zh: 這個裝置可在長時間戶外調查期間隨身佩戴。
exercises.upgrade: portable on the body · 可隨身佩戴的；可在身上攜帶的

options.explanation: portable in a bag = 雖便攜但使用方式不同。
handheld = 長時間調查可能需要騰出雙手。
portable on the body = 長時間隨身使用、無需手持，這個說法最貼切。

exercises.original: The microphone is wearable while the presenter moves around the room.
exercises.zh: 主持人在房間走動時，麥克風可直接佩戴在身上。
exercises.upgrade: portable on the body · 可隨身佩戴的；可在身上攜帶的

options.explanation: portable on the body = moves around + hands-free use 支持 portable on the body。
handheld = 可能可用，但原句強調 wearable。

words.note: 最常見、最自然的名詞化表達之一，指可穿戴在身體上的電子裝置，例如智能手錶、健康追蹤器或感測器。
words.example: A wearable device can monitor heart rate during exercise.
words.exampleZh: 穿戴式裝置可以在運動期間監測心率。

exercises.original: A wearable can track steps, sleep, and heart rate.
exercises.zh: 穿戴式裝置可以追蹤步數、睡眠和心率。
exercises.upgrade: wearable device · 穿戴式裝置

options.explanation: handheld device = 可能追蹤部分資料，但不是穿戴式。
implantable device = 不是一般消費型追蹤器。
accessory = 未表達電子追蹤功能。
wearable device = 作為產品類別時，最自然完整名稱是 wearable device。

exercises.original: The clinic gave each patient a wearable for home monitoring.
exercises.zh: 診所給每名病人一個穿戴式裝置作居家監測。
exercises.upgrade: wearable device · 穿戴式裝置

options.explanation: wearable device = 醫療監測中可佩戴的裝置可直接叫 wearable device。
mobile phone = 可能可監測，但不是原句的類別。
handheld monitor = 會改變佩戴方式。
implantable monitor = 侵入性完全不同。
desktop unit = 不合居家隨身監測。

exercises.original: Sales of wearables increased sharply last year.
exercises.zh: 去年穿戴式裝置銷量大幅上升。
exercises.upgrade: wearable device · 穿戴式裝置

options.explanation: portable electronics = 範圍太廣，包括手機等。
wearable device = 當 wearables 作名詞表示產品類別時，展開為 wearable devices 最自然。
implants = 完全不同產品類型。

words.note: 當 wearable 指整個產品類別或技術領域，而不只是單一裝置時最自然。
words.example: Wearable technology is increasingly used in health monitoring.
words.exampleZh: 穿戴式科技正愈來愈多地應用於健康監測。

exercises.original: Wearable products are becoming more common in healthcare.
exercises.zh: 穿戴式科技在醫療保健領域愈來愈常見。
exercises.upgrade: wearable technology · 穿戴式科技

options.explanation: wearable technology = 若談整個技術領域，而非單一產品，wearable technology 最自然。
handheld technology = 使用方式不同。
implantable technology = 體內而非體表。
mobile technology = 可包括手機、平板。
accessories = 不是技術領域名稱。

exercises.original: The course examines wearable devices and their applications.
exercises.zh: 這門課研究穿戴式科技及其應用。
exercises.upgrade: wearable technology · 穿戴式科技

options.explanation: mobile computing only = 範圍不同。
wearable technology = 課程研究一整類產品與應用，應用 wearable technology。
fashion accessories = 未必有電子功能。

exercises.original: Investment in wearable products has grown rapidly.
exercises.zh: 對穿戴式科技的投資快速增長。
exercises.upgrade: wearable technology · 穿戴式科技

options.explanation: handheld devices = 只是一類裝置。
wearable technology = 產業投資語境中，wearable technology 比單一 device 更自然。
clothing only = wearable technology 不只智能衣物。

words.note: 較簡潔、技術性，常用於感測器、設備和資料收集裝置，表示它直接位於或佩戴於身體上。
words.example: The experiment compared on-body and off-body sensors.
words.exampleZh: 這項實驗比較了身上佩戴式和非身上佩戴式感測器。

exercises.original: The experiment uses wearable sensors to measure posture.
exercises.zh: 這項實驗使用身上佩戴式感測器測量姿勢。
exercises.upgrade: on-body · 身上佩戴的；身體上的

options.explanation: on-body = 研究技術語境中，on-body sensors 是簡潔自然的說法。
handheld sensors = 需手持，使用方式不同。
remote-only sensors = 未佩戴在身上。

exercises.original: The system combines wearable and room-based devices.
exercises.zh: 這套系統結合身上佩戴式和房間固定式裝置。
exercises.upgrade: on-body · 身上佩戴的；身體上的

options.explanation: portable and room-based = portable 未必佩戴。
handheld and room-based = 不是同一分類。
on-body = 和 room-based 對比時，on-body 很精確。

exercises.original: Researchers compared wearable measurements with camera-based measurements.
exercises.zh: 研究人員比較身上佩戴式測量和相機測量。
exercises.upgrade: on-body · 身上佩戴的；身體上的

options.explanation: on-body = 方法分類中，on-body measurements 清楚表示資料來源位於身體上。

words.note: 當 wearable 明確佩戴在手腕上時最精確；常見於智能手錶、健身追蹤器和醫療裝置。
words.example: Participants used a wrist-worn tracker to record daily activity.
words.exampleZh: 參加者使用腕戴式追蹤器記錄每日活動。

exercises.original: Participants used a wearable tracker on the wrist.
exercises.zh: 參加者使用腕戴式追蹤器。
exercises.upgrade: wrist-worn · 腕戴式的

options.explanation: wrist-worn = 佩戴在手腕上的 wearable 最精確叫 wrist-worn。

exercises.original: The study provided each participant with a wearable heart-rate monitor.
exercises.zh: 研究為每名參加者提供腕戴式心率監測器。
exercises.upgrade: wrist-worn · 腕戴式的

options.explanation: wrist-worn = 若裝置像手錶般佩戴在手腕上，wrist-worn 很精確。

exercises.original: The wearable watch records sleep and activity.
exercises.zh: 這款腕戴式手錶記錄睡眠和活動。
exercises.upgrade: wrist-worn · 腕戴式的

options.explanation: clip-on = 手錶不是夾在衣物。
wrist-worn = watch 本身就明確對應 wrist-worn。

words.note: 當裝置佩戴在頭部時適用，例如耳機、頭戴顯示器、頭部感測器；是 wearable 的特定位置型替換。
words.example: The simulation uses a head-worn display.
words.exampleZh: 這個模擬系統使用頭戴式顯示器。

exercises.original: The training system uses a wearable display over the user's eyes.
exercises.zh: 訓練系統使用頭戴式顯示器覆蓋用戶眼睛。
exercises.upgrade: head-worn · 頭戴式的

options.explanation: head-worn = over the user's eyes 明確是 head-worn display。

exercises.original: Pilots tested a wearable display mounted on a helmet.
exercises.zh: 機師測試安裝在頭盔上的頭戴式顯示器。
exercises.upgrade: head-worn · 頭戴式的

options.explanation: portable screen = 可攜帶但未必佩戴。
clip-on belt device = 位置錯誤。
head-worn = 安裝在 helmet 上，head-worn 最精確。

exercises.original: The headset is a wearable device for virtual-reality training.
exercises.zh: 這款頭戴裝置用於虛擬實境訓練。
exercises.upgrade: head-worn · 頭戴式的

options.explanation: head-worn = headset 類裝置本身就是 head-worn。

words.meaning: 夾戴式的；可夾在衣物上的
words.note: 當 wearable 是夾在衣物、腰帶或口袋邊緣上使用時可用；和直接戴在手腕／頭部不同。
words.example: The worker carries a clip-on safety sensor.
words.exampleZh: 工人佩戴一個夾戴式安全感測器。

exercises.original: The worker wears a wearable sensor clipped to the belt.
exercises.zh: 工人佩戴一個夾在腰帶上的夾戴式感測器。
exercises.upgrade: clip-on · 夾戴式的；可夾在衣物上的

options.explanation: clip-on = clipped to the belt 是 clip-on 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The microphone is a small wearable unit attached to the speaker's clothing.
exercises.zh: 這個麥克風是一個夾在講者衣物上的小型夾戴式裝置。
exercises.upgrade: clip-on · 夾戴式的；可夾在衣物上的

options.explanation: handheld = 和 attached to clothing 不符。
clip-on = 附在衣物上的小型裝置最自然是 clip-on。

exercises.original: The badge contains a wearable sensor that attaches to a shirt pocket.
exercises.zh: 這枚名牌內有可夾在恤衫口袋上的感測器。
exercises.upgrade: clip-on · 夾戴式的；可夾在衣物上的

options.explanation: clip-on = attaches to a shirt pocket 明確表示 clip-on form factor。
portable only = 未表達夾附方式。

words.note: 當 wearable technology 直接嵌入衣服、鞋、手套或其他服裝材料時最精確；比一般 wearable 更技術化。
words.example: The prototype uses garment-integrated sensors to measure posture.
words.exampleZh: 這個原型使用整合於衣物中的感測器測量姿勢。

exercises.original: The prototype uses wearable sensors sewn into a shirt.
exercises.zh: 這個原型使用縫在恤衫中的衣物整合式感測器。
exercises.upgrade: garment-integrated · 整合於衣物中的

options.explanation: clip-on = 是夾附，不是縫入衣物。
garment-integrated = sewn into a shirt 是 garment-integrated 的直接線索。

exercises.original: The athletes tested wearable electronics embedded in their training clothes.
exercises.zh: 運動員測試嵌入訓練服中的穿戴式電子設備。
exercises.upgrade: garment-integrated · 整合於衣物中的

options.explanation: garment-integrated = embedded in training clothes 表示電子元件與服裝整合。
clip-on electronics = 沒有 embedded 的整合程度。
wrist-worn devices = 位置和形式不同。

exercises.original: The research shirt contains wearable electrodes within the fabric.
exercises.zh: 這件研究用恤衫在布料中整合了穿戴式電極。
exercises.upgrade: garment-integrated · 整合於衣物中的

options.explanation: clip-on electrodes = 不是夾在外面。
garment-integrated = within the fabric 最精確對應 garment-integrated。
portable electrodes = 未表達 fabric integration。

words.note: 當 wearable 強調電子元件、感測器和數碼功能時可用；比 wearable device 更偏電子技術類別。
words.example: Wearable electronics can collect continuous data during daily activities.
words.exampleZh: 穿戴式電子設備可以在日常活動期間持續收集數據。

exercises.original: The lab develops wearable devices for continuous health monitoring.
exercises.zh: 實驗室開發用於持續健康監測的穿戴式電子設備。
exercises.upgrade: wearable electronics · 穿戴式電子設備

options.explanation: wearable electronics = 當重點是電子感測與數碼功能時，wearable electronics 很自然。
implantable electronics = 不同技術類型。
fashion accessories = 未必具電子功能。

exercises.original: Advances in wearable products have improved real-time data collection.
exercises.zh: 穿戴式電子設備的進步改善了即時數據收集。
exercises.upgrade: wearable electronics · 穿戴式電子設備

options.explanation: portable electronics = 可包括手機和筆電，過廣。
wearable electronics = real-time data collection + 穿戴硬件最適合 wearable electronics。
handheld devices = 使用方式不同。
ordinary accessories = 沒有電子資料功能。

exercises.original: The company produces wearable technology for sports and medical use.
exercises.zh: 公司生產供運動和醫療使用的穿戴式電子設備。
exercises.upgrade: wearable electronics · 穿戴式電子設備

options.explanation: wearable electronics = 公司生產具感測與電子功能的穿戴產品，可概括為 wearable electronics。
clothing only = wearable electronics 不只衣物。

falseSynonyms.zh: 便攜不一定等於 wearable portable 只表示方便攜帶；裝置可能放在袋中或手持，不一定佩戴在身上。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A portable device can be carried without being worn.

falseSynonyms.zh: 流動式不等於穿戴式 mobile 表示可移動或可在移動中使用；手機是 mobile，但通常不算 wearable。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A smartphone is mobile but not usually wearable.

falseSynonyms.zh: 手持式和穿戴式不同 handheld 表示需要用手拿著使用；wearable 通常可以佩戴並讓雙手保持自由。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A handheld device is carried in the hand; a wearable device is worn on the body.

falseSynonyms.zh: 名詞短語不等於形容詞用法 wearable device 是一種裝置類別；單獨的 wearable 也可作形容詞，修飾 sensor、camera、technology 等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Wearable can be an adjective; wearable device is a noun phrase.

falseSynonyms.zh: 固定在身上不一定等同日常 wearable body-mounted 較技術化，常表示設備被固定在身體某處；不一定是消費級 wearable。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Body-mounted equipment may be specialized rather than consumer wearable technology.

falseSynonyms.zh: 植入式不是穿戴式 implantable 裝置位於體內；wearable 裝置則佩戴於身體表面或衣物上。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Implantable devices go inside the body; wearable devices stay on or around it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 配件不一定是 wearable technology accessory 只表示附加物；手袋、飾品都可算 accessory，但未必具穿戴式裝置功能。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An accessory may be wearable, but it is not necessarily a wearable device.

falseSynonyms.zh: 形容詞與動詞不同 wearable 表示可穿戴的；wear 是『穿／戴』這個動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You wear a wearable device.
